svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Multi-tenant cluster with a namespace per team subtitle: Each team gets a namespace with its own RBAC, a ResourceQuota, a LimitRange and a default-deny NetworkPolicy; only the ingress controller reaches their pods direction: down layout: { spacing: compact } legend: solid: Traffic and references dotted: Policy applies to the pods dashed: Denied by NetworkPolicy groups: cluster: { type: k8s:cluster, label: Kubernetes cluster } ingress-ns: { type: k8s:namespace, label: Namespace ingress-nginx, in: cluster } team-a: { type: k8s:namespace, label: Namespace team-a, in: cluster } team-b: { type: k8s:namespace, label: Namespace team-b, in: cluster } nodes: # Each team's group sits above the outer side of its namespace, so its access path stays clear of the traffic. group-a: { icon: k8s:group, label: Group team-a, note: From the OIDC provider } users: { icon: generic:users, label: Users } group-b: { icon: k8s:group, label: Group team-b, note: From the OIDC provider } ingress: { icon: logos:nginx, label: Ingress controller, in: ingress-ns } rb-a: { icon: k8s:rolebinding, label: RoleBinding, note: team-a-devs, in: team-a } np-a: { icon: k8s:networkpolicy, label: NetworkPolicy, note: Default deny, in: team-a } rq-a: { icon: k8s:resourcequota, label: ResourceQuota, note: "8 CPU, 16Gi", in: team-a } lr-a: { icon: k8s:limitrange, label: LimitRange, note: Container defaults, in: team-a } role-a: { icon: k8s:role, label: Role, note: Edit workloads, in: team-a } pods-a: { icon: k8s:pod, label: Pods, note: team-a apps, in: team-a } # team-b lists the same objects in mirror order, so its RoleBinding is on the outer side too. lr-b: { icon: k8s:limitrange, label: LimitRange, note: Container defaults, in: team-b } rq-b: { icon: k8s:resourcequota, label: ResourceQuota, note: "4 CPU, 8Gi", in: team-b } np-b: { icon: k8s:networkpolicy, label: NetworkPolicy, note: Default deny, in: team-b } rb-b: { icon: k8s:rolebinding, label: RoleBinding, note: team-b-devs, in: team-b } pods-b: { icon: k8s:pod, label: Pods, note: team-b apps, in: team-b } role-b: { icon: k8s:role, label: Role, note: Edit workloads, in: team-b } edges: - users -> ingress: HTTPS - ingress -> pods-a, pods-b: HTTP - group-a -> rb-a: subject - rb-a -> role-a - group-b -> rb-b: subject - rb-b -> role-b - np-a, rq-a, lr-a ..> pods-a - lr-b, rq-b, np-b ..> pods-b # A path blocked on purpose is dashed red. Drawn after layout, so the two namespaces stay side by side. - pods-b --> pods-a: { label: denied, color: "#C7243A", constraint: false }

svg.title: Multi-tenant cluster with a namespace per team
svg.desc: Multi-tenant cluster with a namespace per team. 16 components in 4 groups. Connections: Users to Ingress controller (HTTPS); Ingress controller to Pods (HTTP); Ingress controller to Pods (HTTP); Group team-a to RoleBinding (subject); RoleBinding to Role; Group team-b to RoleBinding (subject); RoleBinding to Role; NetworkPolicy to Pods; ResourceQuota to Pods; LimitRange to Pods; LimitRange to Pods; ResourceQuota to Pods; NetworkPolicy to Pods; Pods to Pods (denied).

text.tspan: MULTI-TENANT CLUSTER WITH A NAMESPACE PER TEAM
Each team gets a namespace with its own RBAC, a ResourceQuota, a LimitRange and a default-deny NetworkPolicy; only the ingress controller reaches their pods
